title: upsert sentinel logic duplicated verbatim in upsert and upsert_discovered_contact
description: contact.rs:34-119 and 130-207: both upsert methods contain an identical 30-line block handling created_at_counter sentinel logic (values 0 and -1). Any future change to the sentinel logic must be made in both places. If one is updated and the other is not, the two upsert paths silently diverge. Extract to a private fn stamp_contact_counters(tx, peer_user_id, counter, created_at).
